unit: A notice packet can contain multiple incident and recipient cohorts. Rows below are packet audits; only explicitly identified focal cohorts enter stage calculations.
rules: Discovery, confirmation of exfiltration, first client alert, identification of affected people, consumer mailing, and AG filing are different events.
Unknown dates remain null. A filing date or template placeholder never substitutes for actual consumer mailing.
An announced future mailing remains planned. Conflicting cohort dates remain an interval or an exclusion.
Scope dates describe what the notifying organization reports it learned; they do not independently verify completion of all forensic work.
Host clusters group the compromised operator, not only the common MOVEit software provider. No causal outsourcing coefficient is estimated from this small audit.
